title_zh: 偶像剧：咖啡馆里的浪漫邂逅
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (16/20): Idol Dramas, a Romantic Encounter in a Café
note_en: 虽然……但…… means "although ...": 虽然剧情有时略显夸张，但观众还是会被……深深吸引 "Although the plots can be a bit over the top, viewers are still deeply drawn in." In English, "although" and "but" can't appear together, but Chinese normally uses both, and often adds 还是 ("still") in the second clause as well.
